result.title: LLM Trading Agents Earn Beta, Not Alpha: A Look-Ahead-Free Benchmark
result.comment: 23 pages, 10 figures, 15 tables. Code, frozen markets and leaderboard: https://github.com/jackson-cmd/risk-aware-trading-agents. Original empirical study: a backtest benchmark for LLM trading agents and measurements from 91 runs of six models
result.summary: Large language model (LLM) trading agents now trade stocks for their users, and benchmarks rank models by their agents' returns. Yet a single run's return says little about skill. In our study, two runs of the same model that differed only in the random seed ended 5.2 points apart on average, so telling skill from luck takes many backtests across markets, models and seeds. However, live arenas trade each day only once, and backtests either use the few months after a model's training cutoff or run on years the model may remember, often with news joined to prices by calendar date. In this paper, we present rta-bench-1, a backtest over three US markets (a rally, a bear market and a crash). It shows each headline only after its publication minute, plays each period blind and named, and checks every run for look-ahead. It also splits each return into factor exposure and alpha and scores every decision against random choices of the same day and sector. In 91 runs of six models from four vendors, no alpha was significant, market and style exposure accounted for a median 78% of the return, and the decisions did no better than random stocks of the same sector. The agents bought the stocks with the most positive news, yet in ablations they earned as much without their headlines. Still, the agents carried out rules reliably, since a single cash rule in the prompt cut a GPT-based agent's share in stocks by 30.3 points in all six pairs. Builders should therefore supply the edge themselves and report exposures and alpha, and benchmarks should replay news by publication time.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 rta-bench-1：覆盖三段美国行情、按新闻发布分钟回放且无前视的回测基准，把收益拆为因子暴露与 alpha，并与同日同行业随机选股对比；91 次运行显示无显著 alpha，暴露中位数占收益 78%，决策不优于随机，去掉新闻标题后收益不变。
AI.relevance_reason: 其对「去掉新闻后表现不变」的消融与同分布随机基线，可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据是否被真正使用（视觉旁路）及贡献分配的评价设计参考，但属金融智能体应用，与多模态推理状态生成无直接联系。
